text_block_list.name: Girl with a Guitar
text_block_list.text: ...*sigh*.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
My, sighing doesn't suit you at all.
Where did your usual shout go?

text_block_list.name: Girl with a Guitar
text_block_list.text:
Eh, ah~... I was just catching my breath!
Playing truly kickass music is so tough!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu, okay!
Then I'll show you something wonderful!

text_block_list.name: Girl with a Guitar
text_block_list.text: Wait, this is Santa Monica's concert venue, isn't it?!

text_block_list.name: Girl with a Guitar
text_block_list.text:
To play kickass music, learn from kickass music!
...Is that it?! Pearl-san, you're the best!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Look, it's starting!
Let's enjoy this to the absolute fullest!

text_block_list.name: Girl with a Guitar
text_block_list.text: YEAAAH! Santa Monica is the frickin' best~!

text_block_list.name: Santa Monica
text_block_list.text:
This next one is our final song!!
Let's turn the hype up past the limit, yeahhh!!

text_block_list.name: Girl with a Guitar
text_block_list.text: Ah, this song... Heheh, takes me back.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Fufu, how so?

text_block_list.name: Girl with a Guitar
text_block_list.text:
...Back when I failed my entrance exams,
I came across this song... and Santa Monica.

text_block_list.name: Girl with a Guitar
text_block_list.text:
All my petty worries got blown away
by their shout... Made me realize just how amazing music is—

text_block_list.name: Santa Monica
text_block_list.text: LOVE & PEAAACE!!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Great♪ That really is a wonderful shout.
It's packed with the message they want to convey.

text_block_list.name: Girl with a Guitar
text_block_list.text: The message... they want to convey...

text_block_list.name: Girl with a Guitar
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Pearl-san. ...Do you think my shout
is actually supporting anyone's heart?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Well... It's energetic,
and super cool. I love it.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
...However, it's a sound that pierces like thorns.
I imagine quite a few people would cover their ears.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Isn't that a different "resonance"
from the band you looked up to?

text_block_list.name: Girl with a Guitar
text_block_list.text:
...You're right. Hearing them live again after so long,
I realized I was just copying their style on the surface...

text_block_list.name: Girl with a Guitar
text_block_list.text:
I didn't just want to shout for the sake of shouting.
I wanted to tell people to 'keep looking forward.'
...So where did I go wrong?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
It's fine to make mistakes.
Even if you take a detour, or stop along the way—

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
You've already started running toward your dream.
By your own will, and nobody else's.
That's something you should hold your head high for.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
If you've found the light once again,
then start running, girl.
The path leading to your dream is one only you can walk.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
—Hey hey! She finished her new song.
Wanna give it a listen?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Putting on the earphones just as Seeking the Pearl suggested—
choice_data_list: Somehow... it really touches the heart!
Somehow... it really touches the heart, doesn't it!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
YES!
With this, everyone will definitely embrace it!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
'Even when things are hard, keep looking forward'—
You can really feel that heart coming through, can't you?
choice_data_list: I bet this will resonate with so many people!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Whew! I knew it!
Things are gonna get busy from here on out~!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
First, let's promote it over the academy's PA system!
Then make the rounds greeting live houses and... ah,
we gotta launch an UmaTube channel too!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Still, that's about all I can do.
The rest comes down to her own fight...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Seeking the Pearl was bustling around for the guitar girl, praying earnestly for her success!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Mmm~~♪ Great!
Her burning passion definitely reached you!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Woof, wo-wo-woooah~~!
ROAAAR! That's the vibe, right?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Right?! This masterpiece deserves to be spread everywhere!
I'm gonna broadcast it over the academy's PA right away~~♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: With a cheerful bounce in her step, Seeking the Pearl headed straight for the school building!
